lines: Unemployed jokes are <wavy>flexible</wavy>. That is what I keep telling myself.
Looking useful jokes need timing. Mine usually arrive with time on them.
I keep a spare joke near the job site I have not found yet. It is not always ready for public use.
I told a joke at the village square once. The workstation took it better than the villagers did.
I had a job joke, but it was not hiring.
A workstation joke only works if nobody else claimed it.
My schedule joke is wide open and still late.
I told a chore joke and immediately got assigned one.
A spare hands joke is useful but hard to applaud.
The job board laughed at me. Rude paper.
I know a career joke, but it is still developing.
A flexible joke bends before it breaks.
My best plan joke is currently seeking placement.
I asked the barrel for work. It said hold this.
I tried a busy joke, but nobody believed me.
A broom joke sweeps the room if given time.
The square has many openings and none of them paid me to say that.
I am between punchlines at the moment.
